title: Best way to move Xdrip plus master to new phone
body:
We have Xdrip plus setup with master and one follower my wife's phone is the master she now has a new phone and we need to move master setup over to her new phone what is the best way to do this.
We are using this setup with Libre and Blucon if that matters.

Thank you for this Life changing APP
Chuckk

comments.body:
Install a fresh xdrip on the new phone and on the existing master use the 3 dot menu on the top right and select to share the settings via QR code and then select the all settings option. When the QR code shows use the new phone and in settings select Auto configure from barcode and scan the barcode. It should pick up all the settings (double check your alarms)

If that works then make sure to disable the original master being sync master or you will get in to all kinds of problems.

Thank you Ser went perfect.
And Thank You for ALL you DO

I found this page and this- https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/New-Phone.html

Are there instructions somewhere about disabling the old phone as sync master and setting up the new phone as the new collector mid-sensor?
